description: Christian Doh Dinga and Sander van Rijn publish the demoses-network-interactions code archive for comparing district-heating decarbonisation designs and electricity-grid effects. The associated publisher abstract describes modelling-to-generate-alternatives combined with power-flow simulation for a regional case in the Netherlands. A default-scenario archive and three sensitivity archives provide five- and fifteen-percent cost-slack runs, low and high heat-demand scenarios, and cold-1987 and warm-2004 weather scenarios. This record explicitly includes and links the default workflow and those named scenario outputs. Zenodo makes the March 2026 code and scenario archives free under CC BY 4.0. The public metadata do not establish the implementation language, network dimensions, time step or exact internal file formats. These resources can support reproduction and comparison of heat-electrification planning simulations, but their execution and completeness were not tested. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
